candidates.title: ESI-Bench: Towards Embodied Spatial Intelligence that Closes the Perception-Action Loop
candidates.why_candidate: strong new benchmark for active spatial intelligence with an explicit perception-action loop and OmniGibson grounding

candidates.title: EmbodiedGen V2: An Agentic, Simulation-Ready 3D World Engine for Embodied AI
candidates.why_candidate: direct extension of the repo’s embodied world-engine line with sim-ready assets, task-driven worlds, and cross-simulator export

candidates.title: Interactive World Simulator for Robot Policy Training and Evaluation
candidates.why_candidate: closed-loop action-conditioned world simulator with direct policy-training and policy-evaluation relevance

candidates.title: World Pilot: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models with World-Action Priors
candidates.why_candidate: clean VLA-plus-WAM integration paper with public code and direct real-robot evidence

candidates.title: Being-H0.7: A Latent World-Action Model from Egocentric Videos
candidates.why_candidate: strong frontier world-action model that replaces pixel-space rollout with a compact latent action prior trained from egocentric video

candidates.title: Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI
candidates.why_candidate: major omnimodal world-model release that unifies understanding, generation, simulation, and action for physical AI

candidates.title: pi0.7: General-purpose Robots Learn to Reason from Physical Experience
candidates.why_candidate: major official VLA/update signal, but this run prioritized papers with clearer public technical artifacts and stronger world-model novelty.

candidates.title: Gemini Robotics ER 1.6
candidates.why_candidate: official robotics release signal, but current public artifacts are still more release-oriented than the accepted paper-grade additions in this run.
